applies_to.quote: These Directions shall apply to all Commercial Banks (hereinafter collectively referred to as 'banks' and individually as a 'bank').

answer.action: Commercial banks must calculate and maintain minimum capital requirements for market risk in accordance with these directions starting April 1, 2027.
answer.action_quote: These Directions shall come into effect from April 1, 2027.

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall come into effect from April 1, 2027.
